_what: Where every catalogue option sits on the Ensembl VEP web form, read from the live page.
_release: Ensembl 116 (page title 'Variant Effect Predictor - Homo_sapiens - Ensembl genome browser 116')
_method: Every <input>/<select> on the page mapped to the nearest preceding <h2> in document order; plugins as plugin_<Key>, regulatory/cell type as regulatory_Homo_sapiens / cell_type_Homo_sapiens, gnomAD-SV as custom_custom_homo_sapiens_gnomAD_SV. The <h2> is the box; the six top-level sections are VEPConstants.pm CONFIG_SECTIONS, and each box sits in exactly one of them (checked by DOM ancestry on the same page).
